name: Demon Goblin and Mr. Knight 小鬼哥布林與騎士先生
name_original: Demon Goblin and Mr. Knight 小鬼哥布林與騎士先生
description:
In order to understand and strengthen your own power, you, as a knight in armor, and your partner,Gobulin Lilly, followed the advice of your master and came here to train. In order to become powerful and to be part of your master's group of former mercenaries, you have to master your unfamiliar power as soon as possible.

However, as a Knight of the Fleshclad, you can only gain power when you have intercourse with a woman. To do this, your companion Goblin Lilly becomes your Fleshclad and hangs in front of you in a shameful position, only in this way you can realize your true power.

But that's not enough. To get even stronger, you'll have to keep having sex with other powerful female demons to increase your power.

Constantly Reproducing Levels

As a meat armor knight, you can't level up by defeating demons like normal people, but you can only level up by filling Lilly's body with semen. However, Lilly's womb is limited in size, so she can only go up to level 20 at the most, and when you return to the stronghold, the level will be rebuilt due to the semen flow.

Gameplay

Each area has 100 steps to go, and the player only needs to go all the way to the right. Each step will give the player experience to level up, but each time the player returns to the base point, the level will drop back to LV1.

However, what the player must do is to improve the basic attributes than the loss of level, cooperate with Lilly, capture all kinds of magical women, and have sex with them, to get a permanent increase in the value of the attributes, the future even if only the level of 1, your power is still not to be underestimated.

Different magical creatures can bring different enhancements to the player, and the main way to play is to have sex with different magical creatures as much as possible to get the corresponding enhancements.

Objective

To defeat the main leaders of the forests, ghost towns and deserts.

Defeat the main leaders of “Forest”, “Ghost Town”, and “Desert” to complete the master's test. However, the leaders of these three areas are all powerful and dominate one side, so the main goal of this game is to continuously strengthen yourself by having sex with magical girls on the journey, and to challenge the big leaders to complete the master's test.

Game Features

  • Players are encouraged to capture magical creatures to strengthen them. Each magical creature not only has its own enhanced attributes, but also has its own CG for viewing.

  • Random encounters make your adventure a different experience.

  • Hidden event elements, in addition to winning the target in the map, there are also opportunities to encounter hidden branching events, the completion of the branch will have the opportunity to get better rewards, or hidden CG and skills!

  • Skills are presented in CG, as the player is a knight in armor and must act together with Lilly in battle, this game adds CG to this special way of fighting.

  • There are more than 30 types of capturable magical creatures and special event NPCs, each of which has its own unique CG.

  • The player will be able to walk around the map with animated animation on the screen.
